$comment: NSP-009 — the ratchet behind `npm run spec-ledger` (scripts/node-spec/spec-ledger.js). `floor`: the nodes that conform on the runtime, the nodes specced as a contract (NSP-017 AC3 — the person writes their code: counted apart, never as conforming), and the nodes that conform on the export, and (NSP-020 AC4) the picker nodes whose ports an editor draws without a viewer, held exactly as pickerCoverageFloor is — a fall fails, a rise fails until the floor is raised in the same commit. `owed`: the written reason a picker node is in the picker without a spec yet — the task that will write it. A picker node with no spec, no graph claim, no exemption (exemptions.json) and no entry here fails the PR job, named; an entry that is graded now must be removed in the same commit.
